patch_scope.classification: CPU chat protocol, HTTP control plane and cache synchronization
unchanged: AOTriton, CK and q16384 hybrid providers
patch_scope.inheritance_rule: The complete .4 G1-G4 and two-host portable-userspace evidence may be inherited only when the runtime diff equals the allowlist and every unchanged component hash is exact. Old .4 measurements must never be represented as exact .5 measurements.

target.artifact: one relocatable archive containing the static launcher, native engine, complete pinned userspace, language and vision kernels, licenses, contracts and qualification evidence
target.platform: Linux x86_64 with amdgpu/KFD and AMD gfx1151

capability.image: single and multiple images across the frozen format, aspect, orientation, transparency, dynamic-resolution and count envelope
capability.video: single and multiple videos across the frozen container, fps, duration, frame, sampling and count envelope

sampling.stochastic: temperature in (0,2], top_p in (0,1], optional non-negative seed
sampling.logits: exact full-vocabulary BF16 projection from raw LM-head weights

runtime.chat_executor: one bounded serial executor with control-plane routing on the accept loop

patch_required: exact unchanged provider and AOT hashes
exact-candidate HTTP concurrency and shutdown qualification
rollback to the exact v1.5.1 portable baseline

performance.inheritance: The .4 text and VL measurements remain applicable only to unchanged GPU execution paths; .5 makes no new throughput claim.
performance.http: Health and shutdown control-plane requests remain bounded while chat inference is active; accepted chats execute serially.

security.local_media: explicit roots, descriptor-relative traversal, O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file and stable-metadata checks, byte limits
security.remote_media: per-hop hostname allowlist, DNS address checks, redirect/deadline/byte limits, HTTPS downgrade and credential rejection, no proxy inheritance
security.authentication: bearer authentication and fail-closed remote bind retained
security.logging: media payloads, credentials, hostnames and private paths are excluded from public patch evidence
